response.overview: Two college friends, Alex and Rahul, come up with an unconventional business idea when they recruit a quiet coding prodigy, Subbu, to complete projects and assignments for fellow students. What begins as a small side hustle soon turns into a thriving campus venture, complete with samosas, questionable business deals, and unexpected competition. But when Subbu decides to launch his own startup with a new partner, the duo are left stunned. A light-hearted campus comedy about friendship, ambition, and the business of getting things done.
response.tagline: "And never, ever underestimate a topper with a samosa."
response.title: SYNDICATE
